BeaconDescription.en: One per base. Use a powered beacon to travel to another living base with a powered beacon.
BeaconDescription.chi: 每基地最多一座。靠近有电信标按E，可前往其他拥有有效信标的存活基地。

BeaconNoDestinations.en: No other powered base beacon is available.
BeaconNoDestinations.chi: 其他基地暂无可用的有电信标。

BeaconUnavailable.en: Aim at a nearby existing beacon.
BeaconUnavailable.chi: 请瞄准近处现存的信标。

BeaconBaseDestroyed.en: Base {1} has been destroyed. Travel is disabled; the remaining beacon can still be managed.
BeaconBaseDestroyed.chi: 基地 {1} 已被摧毁，信标无法传送，仍可管理现存信标。

BeaconNoPower.en: This beacon is unpowered. Travel is disabled; management remains available.
BeaconNoPower.chi: 此信标当前缺电，无法传送，仍可管理。

BeaconMenuExpired.en: The beacon or destination changed. Aim at the source beacon and open its menu again.
BeaconMenuExpired.chi: 信标或目的地已变化，请重新瞄准源信标打开菜单。

BeaconTravelFailed.en: No safe landing point is available at that base. You stayed where you were.
BeaconTravelFailed.chi: 该基地暂无安全落点，已留在原处。
